metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.6 · 1984 · Children of the Corn
metas.description: A young couple is trapped in a remote town where a dangerous religious cult of children believes that everyone over age 18 must be killed.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.4 · 1992 · Children of the Corn II: The Final Sacrifice
metas.description: A journalist and his son travel to Nebraska to investigate the mysterious town of Gatlin where, unbeknownst to them, a murderous cult of children are still waiting in the corn fields.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.4 · 1995 · Children of the Corn III: Urban Harvest
metas.description: Two brothers connected to the murderous children's cult of Gatlin, Nebraska are taken to Chicago by an adoptive couple.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.6 · 2011 · Children of the Corn: Genesis
metas.description: A young couple try to free an imprisoned child with catastrophic results.
